name: Serena Launch
oneLiner: Find curated launch-video references, watch the originals, and get a remake prompt for your product.
description: Explore Serena Tan’s curated collection of launch-video references from Claude. Search by keywords, visual style, category and aspect ratio; compare original source videos and dated engagement snapshots; and retrieve reference metadata with a concise remake prompt. Each tool reads the current published collection, so new references and editorial formats are available without reinstalling. The connector is read-only: it does not render videos, upload content, post to social platforms or modify your accounts. Reference creators and source posts remain credited.

authentication.accountRequirement: Sign in with your own Google account. The same complete reference collection is available to every signed-in user. No paid plan is required.

dataHandling: The MCP API is operated by Serena Tan and serves the first-party curated catalog from the project repository. It returns third-party reference-post URLs, reference videos and dated public-source metadata with source attribution. It does not query arbitrary APIs, personal files, conversation history or personal health data. Authentication is provided by Clerk and Google; hosting is on Cloudflare. Login is not a newsletter subscription.
reviewerAccess: Reviewers may create a free account using their own Google account through the OAuth flow; all catalog tools and references are immediately available. Do not use the publisher’s personal credentials. A dedicated reviewer account is not yet configured; confirm the portal’s requirement.
useCases: Find launch-video visual references for a product and compare styles.
Find square UI-motion references and inspect original-source videos.
